channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Layers in a Phlegra Montes Impact Crater
item.description: The objective of this observation is to examine at least two layers that are exposed in the wall of an impact crater that’s less than 5 kilometers across. Even without a 3D picture, we can easily see that the crater’s walls are fairly steep. Phlegra Montes are a series of mountain ranges, massifs and knobby terrain in the Northern lowlands of Mars. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
